role: frequency-ordered word list (full list; the app bundles its head as the seed)
generationVersion: gen-tatoeba-words.py v1 (HKeyboard scripts/; devanagari script filter, whose vowel signs / virama / anusvara are letters of the word)
generationCommand: python scripts/gen-tatoeba-words.py --lang ne --script devanagari --min-count 3 --stop <placeholder names> --out ne_words.txt npi_text.txt
transformations: gen-tatoeba-words.py: tokens of Devanagari letters and their combining marks; Tatoeba placeholder names dropped (--stop: Tom's and Mary's inflected forms - the bare 'meri' is kept, it is also the feminine 'my'); words seen fewer than 3 times dropped; ordered by count desc then first occurrence
no corpus sentence is redistributed - the file is a word list only
note: The app bundles the top 900 lines as its seed and downloads this full list on the user's request.
